FY 2025/26 — SEED DATA INTEGRITY REVIEW
How real is the
APEX NEXUS data?

Every KPI, narrative, and institutional figure in this platform was cross-referenced against live Ugandan government statistics, World Bank data, UBOS surveys, and sector-specific sources. Here is the full picture.

Agriculture & Exports
PD-002 · MAAIF / NAADS / OWC
METRIC	SEED VALUE	REAL (2025/26)	SOURCE	VERDICT

Coffee export revenue
PD-002 narrative
	USD 1.1B	USD 2.4B (Nov 24–Oct 25)	Uganda Coffee Development Authority / Ministry of Agriculture monthly report	Understated 2×
Seed reflects FY23/24 peak. Uganda became Africa's top exporter in 2025 with a 77% value surge


OWC household reach
PD-002 KPI
	2.64M of 2.8M target	2.5–3M range	OWC operational reports; all 146 districts active	Plausible
No public figure contradicts this range


Agriculture GDP growth
PD-002 KPI
	5.8% actual	~4–5% (World Bank 2025)	World Bank Uganda GDP tracker; overall growth 6.1% in 2025	Slightly optimistic
Agriculture typically lags headline GDP; 5.8% is achievable but bullish
Tourism
PD-007 · UTB / UWA
METRIC	SEED VALUE	REAL (2025/26)	SOURCE	VERDICT

International arrivals
PD-007 KPI
	1.72M	1.64M (2025)	Ministry of Tourism Statistical Abstract 2025	Accurate
~5% variance — well within demo tolerance


Tourism revenue
PD-007 KPI
	USD 2.1B	USD 1.62B (UGX 5.8T)	Ministry of Tourism / UBOS Tourism Satellite Account	Overstated ~30%
$2.1B is a plausible FY2026/27 projection but not current


Gorilla permits issued
PD-007 KPI
	19,400	~15K–20K (UWA)	Uganda Wildlife Authority annual permit data	Accurate
Bwindi + Mgahinga combined capacity consistent; Rushaga expansion plausible
Financial Inclusion
PD-009 · Bank of Uganda / UMRA
METRIC	SEED VALUE	REAL (2025/26)	SOURCE	VERDICT

Adults with bank/mobile account
PD-009 KPI
	73%	64–73% (BoU / Finscope)	Bank of Uganda Q1 2025 quarterly review; 33.7M active accounts	Accurate
Seed aligns with BoU's headline metric; Finscope 2023 puts usage at 64% — methodology differs


Mobile money transactions
PD-009 KPI
	204M/quarter	High hundreds of millions	BoU quarterly financial stability reports; 20.9% volume growth YoY	Conservative
At 33.7M accounts, 204M quarterly transactions (6 txns/user/quarter) is actually low
Oil & Gas — EACOP / Tilenga
PD-006 · MEMD / UNOC / TotalEnergies
METRIC	SEED VALUE	REAL (APR 2026)	SOURCE	VERDICT

EACOP pipeline completion
PD-006 KPI — primary
	38%	82%	EACOP Company official project update, April 2026. Marine jetty at 88.1%	Critical error — 44pp gap
Biggest factual discrepancy in the dataset. Seed appears to reference mid-2024 figures


First oil target
PD-006 narrative
	Late 2027	October 2026	EACOP Company / Wikipedia revised commissioning date	~1 year behind
Project advancing rapidly; October 2026 is the current target


NGO litigation impact
PD-006 narrative framing
	Litigation slowing progress	Litigation exists; construction unaffected	TotalEnergies project statements; French / EU court proceedings ongoing	Partially accurate
Litigation is real but has not stopped construction — the framing overstates delay
Corruption & Governance
PD-014 · IGG / DPP / FIA
METRIC	SEED VALUE	REAL (2025)	SOURCE	VERDICT

CPI score
PD-014 KPI
	26/100 (actual)	25/100 (2025)	Transparency International CPI 2025. Ranked 148/182 countries	Accurate
One point variance — seed used 2024 score. Both reflect the same sustained stagnation


Corruption trend
PD-014 completion 29%
	Stagnant, near-flat	27→26→26→25 (2021–2025)	TI historical dataset; four-year plateau	Highly accurate
RED status and 29% completion are entirely justified by the data
Youth Employment
PD-016 · MGLSD / YLP / UYEP
METRIC	SEED VALUE	REAL (UBOS 2026)	SOURCE	VERDICT

Youth unemployment rate
PD-016 KPI
	18.2%	17.9%	UBOS Labour Market Survey 2025, disseminated April 2026	Precise
0.3pp variance. Note: World Bank uses narrower ILO definition (~4.5%) — seed correctly uses UBOS broader measure


YLP loan recovery rate
DX-006 discrepancy
	42% reported / 28% actual	Recovery widely cited as poor (~30–40%)	Parliamentary debates; IG investigation reports; media coverage	Accurate
The discrepancy scenario mirrors documented IG-type findings on YLP
Health
PD-005 · MoH / NMS / UVRI
METRIC	SEED VALUE	REAL (WHO/MOH 2024)	SOURCE	VERDICT

Maternal mortality ratio
PD-005 KPI
	264/100K LB	170–189/100K LB	WHO 2022 estimate: 189. World Bank 2023 model: 170	~40% overstated
Seed uses 2019-era data (~284). Current WHO figure is 189; World Bank 2023 model gives 170


DPT3 vaccine coverage
PD-005 KPI
	88%	87–91%	UNICEF immunization data; MoH annual health sector performance report	Accurate
Consistently in this range across multiple sources


NMS stockout field finding
DX-005 / FR-2026-112
	56% of HCs with stockouts	Stockouts a documented ongoing issue	MoH sector reports; northern region findings consistent with field data	Plausible
Northern region stockouts are well-documented; 56% is on the high end but defensible
Tax & Private Sector
PD-021 · MoFPED / URA / PSFU
METRIC	SEED VALUE	REAL (URA / WORLD BANK)	SOURCE	VERDICT

Tax revenue to GDP
PD-021 KPI
	15.1% actual	13.4–14.5%	World Bank 2023: 13%; IMF FY2025 projection: 14.5%; Monitor Apr 2026: 13–14%	Overstated ~1.5pp
Government's own 2030 target is 18%. 15.1% is aspirational, not current reality


URA domestic revenue
PD-021 narrative
	UGX 32.4T	~UGX 32T (FY2024/25)	Monitor confirmed domestic revenues reached ~UGX 32T in FY2024/25	Precise
Spot-on. 46% growth over 4 years confirmed
Key findings
✓
Youth & corruption data is publication-grade
Youth unemployment (18.2% vs UBOS 17.9%), CPI score (26 vs TI's 25), and URA revenue figure (UGX 32.4T) are all within rounding distance of official published data.
✓
Institutional framing is well-grounded
YLP loan recovery problems, northern region HC stockouts, NMS supply chain failures, and IG discrepancy patterns all reflect documented real institutional challenges.
!
Coffee & tourism figures need updating
Coffee export revenue (seed $1.1B vs actual $2.4B) reflects FY23/24 data. Tourism revenue ($2.1B vs $1.62B) is a future projection presented as current. Both undermine PD-002 and PD-007.
!
Maternal mortality uses outdated baseline
The seed value of 264/100K live births reflects the 2019 WHO estimate. Current WHO data (2022) puts Uganda at 189/100K — a significant documented improvement the seed has not captured.
✕
EACOP completion is the critical error
Seed shows 38% pipeline completion. EACOP Company confirmed 82% by April 2026. This 44-percentage-point gap would be immediately spotted by anyone from MEMD or UNOC. Priority fix.
✕
Tax/GDP ratio and first oil timeline are off
Tax/GDP stated at 15.1% vs actual 13.4–14%. First oil target placed at "late 2027" vs the revised October 2026 commissioning date. Both are verifiable by MoFPED and MEMD stakeholders.
APEX NEXUS · Seed Data Integrity Audit · FY 2025/26
Sources: UCDA, UTB, UBOS, BoU, TI, EACOP Co., WHO, World Bank, TotalEnergies, Monitor, URA
